source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

items.name: Bully the Bully
items.text:
Augsten's sense of strength and self-worth shatters whenever someone calls him "Little Lord Augie." A PC can attempt to send Augsten into a tantrum by calling him by this insult as part of a special attempt to create-a-diversion dc=24 traits=auditory,linguistic that has the auditory and linguistic traits, with the following results.

---
Critical Success Augsten is cut deep by your teasing! He becomes Stunned 1 by his rage, and is Off-Guard to your attacks for the next 24 hours. During this time, he takes a –4 circumstance penalty to all attempts to use demoralize on any target, and can't use Bullying Command.

Effect: Bully the Bully (Critical Success)

Success Your insult enrages Augsten, causing him to become off-guard to your attacks until the start of his next turn as he's distracted by his anger. The next attempt to insult him using this by any PC gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the Deception check.

Failure Your attempt fails to rile Augsten up, but it does attract his attention. He focuses his attacks on you on his next turn.

Critical Failure Your attempt to tease Augsten backfires, and instead of sending him into a sputtering tantrum, you enrage him. He gains a +2 status bonus to all damage rolls against you for the next 24 hours, during which time you cannot attempt to Bully the Bully. Augsten favors you as his target for all attacks during this time.

Effect: Bully the Bully (Critical Failure)

items.name: Reactive Bullying
items.text:
Trigger A creature Augsten can see fails an attack roll or skill check

---
Effect Augsten attempts to demoralize the triggering creature by taunting it with cruel laughter and insults about its ability.

items.name: Bullying Command
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Augsten bellows out an insulting, bullying order to a bugbear tormentor he can see. That bugbear tormentor becomes Quickened until the end of their next turn, and can use the extra action to Interact, Step, Stride, or Strike.

items.name: Cruel Lashes
items.text: When Augsten wields a whip, the whip loses its nonlethal trait. He deals an additional 1d6 precision damage with a whip against frightened foes.

items.name: Cudgeling Blow
items.text:
Requirements Augsten is carrying his cudgel in one hand

Frequency once per round

---
Effect Augsten smashes his cudgel against an adjacent creature with astonishing force, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning damage and forcing the target to attempt a DC 26 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Off-Guard until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is knocked Prone, and is off-guard until the start of its next turn.
